tools.name: swt-detection
tools.description: Detects scenes containing text in video (slates, chyrons, credits, lower-thirds). Produces TimeFrame annotations marking where text appears with classification labels and confidence scores. Run this FIRST when you need to find on-screen text, speaker chyrons, or title cards.

useClassifier.description: Use CNN classifier for text scene classification

tfLabelMapPreset.description: Preset for mapping raw labels to output labels

tools.when_to_use: When the question involves on-screen text, speaker identification from chyrons, title cards, credits, or any text that appears visually on screen.

tools.name: parakeet-wrapper
tools.description: NVIDIA Parakeet ASR: transcribes speech to text with word-level timestamps. Uses NeMo TDT 0.6B model. Non-autoregressive architecture avoids repetition artifacts. Produces a full transcript with time-aligned tokens.
tools.when_to_use: When the question involves what someone said, speech content, spoken names, dialogue, or any information conveyed through audio/speech.

tools.name: whisper-wrapper
tools.description: OpenAI Whisper ASR: alternative speech-to-text. Autoregressive model, may produce repetition on certain content. Use parakeet-wrapper as preferred alternative.
tools.when_to_use: Alternative to parakeet-wrapper. Use when parakeet fails or for comparison.

tools.name: transnet-wrapper
tools.description: TransNetV2 shot boundary detection: identifies visual transitions (cuts, dissolves) to segment the video into coherent shots. Each shot is a continuous visual unit. Run this BEFORE visual captioning to define the segments to caption.
tools.when_to_use: When the question involves visual content, b-roll footage, what was shown on screen, or you need to identify distinct visual segments before captioning.

tools.name: qwen3vl-captioner
tools.description: Qwen 2.5-VL 3B vision-language model for captioning and OCR. Has TWO modes controlled by the 'config' parameter: (1) swt_transcription - reads on-screen text from SWT-detected text scenes (requires swt-detection output), (2) transnet_shots - describes visual content of each shot (requires transnet-wrapper output). Choose the right config based on what information you need.

config.description: swt_transcription: OCR on text scenes. transnet_shots: visual captioning of shots.

tools.when_to_use: Use with swt_transcription config to READ on-screen text (chyrons, titles, credits). Use with transnet_shots config to DESCRIBE visual content (b-roll, scenes, graphics, maps).

tools.name: spacy-wrapper
tools.description: SpaCy named entity recognition: extracts PERSON, ORG, GPE, DATE, etc. from text. Run on ASR transcripts or OCR text to identify who and what is mentioned.
tools.when_to_use: When the question involves identifying specific people, organizations, or locations mentioned in the video.

tools.name: ffmpeg:get_video_info
tools.description: Get video metadata: duration, resolution, codec, FPS, file size. Always run this first to understand what you're working with.
tools.when_to_use: Always run first to get video duration and properties.

tools.name: ffmpeg:extract_frame
tools.description: Extract a single frame from the video at a specific timestamp. Use after identifying a relevant time range to get a frame for visual inspection by a VLM.

timestamp_seconds.description: Time in seconds to extract frame

tools.when_to_use: When you need to visually inspect a specific moment in the video, e.g., to verify what a graphic or chyron shows.
